justifications.A: The harness reports lint, typecheck, test_js and phpcs all passing.
justifications.B: `src/desktop.ts` adds a `{ title: 'Tile all windows', url: '', onSelect: () => manager.tile() }` row in the System rows (the agent says it sits right after Fullscreen, but the zero-context hunk can't show the neighbouring row), and `pickGridDimensions` now returns `{ cols: n, rows: 1 }` when `n <= 3 && width >= height`, so three windows go in thirds while two stay at 2x1 and four keep the existing 2x2.
justifications.C: The menu row calls the existing `manager.tile()`, and the only layout changes are a small early return in the picker and a tweak to the `mins` computation in `arrange.ts`.
justifications.D: No edits under `assets/js/`, no raw fetch/confirm/alert, no `:host` tokens, no `@since` stamps and no new ESLint disables.
justifications.E: Two cases go into the existing `tests/vitest/arrange.test.ts`: three windows in thirds (equal 514px widths, same top) and the short-last-row stretch (778px each); both cover behaviour that could regress.
justifications.F: `docs/javascript-reference.md` replaces the 'no UI of their own' claim for `tile()` with 'the System tile's **Tile all windows** row', keeps the claim only for `cascade()`/`setSnapEnabled()`, and documents the new grid rules.
justifications.G: Only the five relevant files change; the `arrange.ts` edit (`members.map(...)` for `mins`) goes beyond the letter of the task, but it serves the 'use the available space' requirement and has a test.
justifications.H: The final message says it ran `npm run build`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm run test:js` (6,616 tests passed), which matches the all-pass gates.

notable: This is a small change that reuses the existing code: the menu row calls the existing `tile()`, and three-in-thirds comes from a three-line rule in `pickGridDimensions`, with tests and docs in the same change. Note that the criteria maxima add up to 19, not the stated 20, so 19 is a perfect score.
